scope:
Package K2c-1 (KERNEL, small-to-medium; no web): UNITS (projects / teams / organisations a conversation belongs to) and the PROVENANCE of memory notes, as actions + data, so the 'Ty' screen (W2b) can show and edit them. Source of truth: docs/architecture/M1_USTAWIENIA_JAKO_GRAF_2026-10-16.md section '3.7 Graf > Ty' (bullets 'Siec: ... Jednostki' and 'Co pamietam') and item '### M1-K2' (the parts about units.define, conversation.set_unit and 'MemoryNode.metadata.provenance'); read only those. Branch claude/m1-w0 is at 01dd2319 (W2a + fixes on main); the tree is clean.
The owner's rules: nothing is decided for the person; every write of the person's data asks first through the EXISTING confirmation mechanism (see how rules.set / settings.set / profile.set are gated: action_rules.pack confirm:<action> + run_gated); defaults are presets; old data is never rewritten silently - an old note without provenance says 'pochodzenie nieznane (zapisane przed M1)', it is not given a made-up origin; words are DATA pl+en (chat_ops.pack / the pack the neighbours use), no literals in C++; his lists are examples (unit kinds: project / team / organization are SEEDS - read the real unit_kinds from graph_views.pack / chat_ops.pack and add the ones the philosophy implies, saying what you added).
FACTS (checked by S1, verify): unit_kinds appear in loom/data/runtime/graph_views.pack, chat_ops.pack, loom/src/graph/projection.cpp and loom/src/views/scope_resolver.cpp (around line 96 there is already a READER of conversations.metadata.units that gives the scope chain a 'project' level); there is NO writer yet. The profile subgraph kinds exist as data: loom/data/profiles/user.pack 'loom.profile_subgraphs/1' (~line 148). Memory notes live in memory.json (loom/src/memory/memory_engine.cpp, MemoryNode with a free-form metadata JSON; Python compat: metadata is just JSON so a new key is compatible; compat tests live in loom/tests/compat/ - run them). The actions framework: loom/src/actions/ops.cpp + loom/data/runtime/actions.pack (catalogue) + chat_ops.pack (words) + action_rules.pack (confirm gates) + chat_coverage.pack (K2b-2 made `chat_outcome` DATA: pending|executed|unavailable|continuation + reason pl/en - every new action needs an entry; a free sentence that cannot supply the params is 'unavailable' with the reason, unless the router can fill them honestly from the sentence, as profile.set does with 'zapisz o mnie pole=wartosc'). A conversation record: conversations table, ConvPatch for metadata updates (find how the existing conversation.* actions patch metadata, e.g. title/pin).
BUILD, commit after each: (1) units.define {kind, id, label?} (gated: confirm) -> a node unit:<kind>/<id> in `nodes` (kind 'unit', metadata.unit_kind from unit_kinds, label, created) - idempotent for the same kind+id (a second define updates the label only after confirm, never silently); units.list {kind?} (read-only, with the number of conversations per unit); units.forget {kind,id} (gated; removes the node and the assignment from conversations ONLY after confirm, and says how many conversations are affected). (2) conversation.set_unit {conv_id?, kind, id} / conversation.clear_unit {conv_id?, kind} (gated; conv_id defaults to the open conversation): writes conversations.metadata.units = {<kind>: <id>} through ConvPatch (merge, never overwrite other metadata keys such as flow=profile.interview); the scope chain then sees the level (scope_resolver already reads it - add a test that a unit-level setting/rule applies to a conversation after set_unit and stops after clear_unit). (3) MEMORY PROVENANCE: every WRITE path of memory notes (memory.remember / the memory tree add path / import / folder attach / guardian writes - grep memory_engine.cpp and ops.cpp for the real list, and the existing op for attaching a folder if present) stamps metadata.provenance = {source: user|import|folder|guardian, time (ISO, same format as the rest), ref (message id / file / run id if known, else absent)}; READ side: memory.recall / the memory list answers include provenance (or the words 'pochodzenie nieznane (zapisane przed M1)' for old notes) - find the read actions and add a field `provenance` (additive) and a pl/en phrase; the receipt per-element items for memory nodes (K1c-2 B) may carry it later - do not change the receipt in this package. (4) CATALOGUE + WORDS + COVERAGE: actions.pack entries (params, pl+en descriptions, read-only flags), action_rules.pack confirm rules, chat_ops.pack sentences (plain, no internal names - the K2b-2 test over profile words shows the style: no snake_case, dotted ids, true/false, '=' in visible strings; extend that kind of data-driven check to your new sentences), chat_coverage.pack entries with chat_outcome; regenerate runtime_profiles_embedded.inc (python3 loom/src/model/gen_runtime_profiles.py, then --check); route literals: if loom/web/src/api/*.ts is untouched there are none to register, but the HTTP facade derives routes from actions.pack - run the registry chain if graph/interfaces.pack changes (python3 loom/tools/gen_graph_interfaces.py -> gen_runtime_profiles.py (then --check) -> re-pin sha256 of changed packs in loom/data/data_domains.pack (rom.pack too: python3 loom/tools/gen_rom_catalogue.py?) -> ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj|rom'). (5) TESTS (doctest; no network; mock nothing that needs a model): units define/list/forget with confirm (nothing written before the yes; counts of affected conversations), set_unit merges metadata and keeps flow, the scope chain effect, provenance stamped on every memory write path and absent-but-worded for an old note (write an old-format memory.json fixture), the Python compat tests unchanged and green, the K2b-2 style words check on the new sentences, chat_coverage test passes (this test failed the gate once - ctest -R 'chat|route|coverage|actions' MUST be in your run).
ASAN DISCIPLINE (two ASan-only classes bit us; CI is the only place that proves them and CI takes 2 hours): (a) never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary; (b) NEVER hold a pointer or reference into a Json/state object across a call that can assign to or grow it (write(), apply(), a setter): take a COPY (std::optional<Json> or by-value) or re-look-up after the call. Read your own diff once with exactly these two questions before you commit.
DECISIONS ARE YOURS (R1-R53): record each with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K2c1' in docs/reports/INDEX.md. Do NOT touch loom/android/smoke/*, loom/web (W2b), the golden chat_request_legacy.json, the receipt schema. If after about 70 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.

The card pastes: one answer of each new action in pl (define with its confirmation question, list, set_unit, clear_unit, forget with the count), a memory read answer with provenance for a new note and the wording for an old one, the list of memory write paths you stamped (and any you could not), the 'what I added to the unit kinds' note, and exactly what is left for K2c-2 (party:self subgraph projection) and W2b.
